source.event_source: Bank of Japan official policy-decision releases
source.price_source: 225Labo source-provided 1-minute JNU Micro data, locally transformed to non-reconstructive per-event aggregates
source.eligible_holdout: First official BOJ MPM decision events strictly after cutoff whose frozen baseline/event windows are fully inside the same eligible OSE day-session segment.

holdout.rationale: One fixed forward batch of eight eligible policy-decision events; count frozen before any post-cutoff event-price outcome inspection.
holdout.pending_behavior: If fewer than 8 eligible post-cutoff events exist, report only event count, dates/provenance availability and data-integrity status. Do not compute or reveal effect mean, median, bootstrap probability or event-level effects.
holdout.leakage_rule: No event on or before 2026-07-31 may enter Stage8.

frozen_measurement.transform: Identical to Stage A/B; no window or measurement change.

pass_all: Exactly 8 preregistered forward eligible events are evaluated

interpretation.pass: STAGE8_FORWARD_EVENT_HOLDOUT_PASS; proceed to Stage9 role-consistent validation review for event/risk-state use only.
interpretation.fail: STAGE8_FORWARD_EVENT_HOLDOUT_FAIL_CURRENT_SPEC; BOJ parent event-state remains non-validated and cannot be rescued by changing windows/event subsets.

forbidden: Inspect partial post-cutoff event-effect performance before 8 events
Select only hikes, cuts, surprises, or favorable event types after outcomes
Change bootstrap samples, seed or 0.95 threshold
Use directional returns as Stage8 evidence
Use Stage8 event-state PASS as directional alpha
next_action: Implement fail-closed Stage8 runner/selftest. Until 8 new eligible events exist, no event-effect metrics may be calculated or emitted.
